Tùy chỉnh nút (HUD): Hãy sắp xếp các nút bấm (bắn, nhảy, ngồi, đặt Bom Keo) sao cho thuận tay nhất. Nếu bạn quen chơi các game FPS khác, hãy đặt vị trí tương tự để không bị nhầm. 2. Đừng quên nhặt Bom Keo (Gloo Wall) – đây là vật phẩm "cứu mạng" quan trọng nhất trong Free Fire để tạo lá chắn tức thời. 3. Kỹ thuật "Kéo tâm": Để bắn vào đầu (headshot) dễ hơn, khi nhấn nút bắn, bạn hãy vuốt nhẹ nút đó lên phía trên. Di chuyển linh hoạt: Đừng đứng yên khi bắn. desc: Ingredients: For the chicken: - 1½ lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into small pieces - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp garlic powder - ½ tsp onion powder - ½ tsp chili powder - ½ tsp salt - ¼ tsp black pepper For the sticky hot honey garlic sauce: - ⅓ cup honey - 2 tbsp hot sauce - 3 cloves garlic, minced - 1 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp soy sauce - ½ tsp red pepper flakes For the creamy jalapeño ranch: - ½ cup ranch dressing - 1 small jalapeño, finely chopped - 1 tbsp lime juice - 2 tbsp chopped cilantro For the tacos: - 8 small flour tortillas - 1½ cups shredded Monterey Jack cheese - 1 cup shredded lettuce or cabbage - ½ cup diced tomatoes - ¼ cup diced red onion - Fresh cilantro - Lime wedges Instructions: 1️⃣ Season and cook the chicken. Toss chicken with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply golden and cooked through to 165°F. 2️⃣ Make the sticky sauce. Lower the heat slightly. Add butter and garlic to the skillet and cook for 20–30 seconds. Stir in honey, hot sauce, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes. Let it bubble for 1–2 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened. Toss the chicken until every piece is coated. 3️⃣ Mix the jalapeño ranch. Stir together ranch, jalapeño, lime juice, and cilantro. If you’re craving steakhouse flavor without the steakhouse price, this is it! Tender, garlic butter steak bites paired with rich, creamy Parmesan shells make an easy dinner that tastes like it took hours. It’s a 30-minute meal that’s perfect for busy weeknights but impressive enough for guests. Servings: 4 Recipe Ingredients For the Steak 1½ lbs sirloin steak, cut into bite-sized pieces 2 tbsp olive oil 3 tbsp butter 5 cloves garlic, minced 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tsp Montreal steak seasoning Salt and black pepper to taste Fresh parsley, chopped For the Parmesan Shells 12 oz medium pasta shells 2 tbsp butter 3 cloves garlic, minced 1½ cups heavy cream 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese ½ tsp Italian seasoning Salt and pepper to taste Instructions 1. Cook the pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Heat olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over high heat. 3. Season the steak with Montreal seasoning, salt, and pepper. Sear for 2–3 minutes without moving, then flip and cook another 2 minutes. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add the butter, garlic, and Worcestershire sauce. Toss the steak until coated. Remove from the pan. 5. In a separate saucepan, melt butter and sauté the garlic for 30 seconds. 6. Add the heavy cream and Italian seasoning. Simmer for 2–3 minutes. 7. Stir in the Parmesan until melted and smooth. 8. Toss in the cooked pasta shells and coat well. 9. Serve the garlic butter steak bites over the creamy shells and garnish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesans #SteakBites #EasyDinnerIdeas #ComfortFood #DinnerIn30 #TikTokFood
